behavior_constraints: Gradient spike detection uses EWMA (alpha=0.1) over grad_norm values in timeline order, tracking EWMA mean and EWMA variance.
Gradient spike detection requires a minimum warmup of 30 entries before any anomaly is emitted.
Gradient spike is triggered when EWMA-based z_score > 2.5.
Gradient spike severity is high when z_score > 4.0, otherwise medium.
Gradient spike anomaly details object includes observed (current grad_norm), ewma_mean, ewma_stddev (sqrt of EWMA variance), and z_score.
Loss divergence detection uses EMA (alpha=0.05) over loss values in timeline order instead of comparing window endpoints.
Loss divergence is triggered when current_loss > 2.0 * ema_loss.
Loss divergence detection is suppressed when abs(ema_loss) <= 1e-6.
Loss divergence severity is critical when current_loss / ema_loss > 5.0, otherwise high.
Loss divergence anomaly details object includes current_loss, ema_loss, and ratio (current_loss / ema_loss).
entities.summary: This round replaces sliding-window statistics in gradient spike detection with EWMA-based Z-scoring and replaces endpoint comparison in loss divergence detection with EMA-based ratio comparison, updating analysis_rules.md accordingly.
